questions.stem: Manufacturer of a drug company labels the drug contains 500 mg Paracetamol. On quantitative analysis by the authorities, it was found to contain only 200 mg of drug. According to drugs and cosmetics act 1940, this type of drug is known as?
questions.solutionHtml:
Misbranded Drug
  • Misbranded drug: Any wrong information on the label or in other words, any drug for which the label is in any way false or misleading.
  • Such conduct as set forth in paragraphs (1) and (2) of the Findings of Fact Section constitutes a violation of section 3715.64(A).

questions.stem: A 20 year old boy was brought to emergency room after consuming some unknown substance. The patient was sweating profusely, saliva was drooling from mouth and tears were present. The boy suffered involuntary urination and diarrhea. On examination, the heart rate was 58 beats per minutes and blood pressure was 80/60 mm hg. Which of the following is the drug of choice for the treatment of this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Atropine
  • This clinical scenario is suggestive of Mushroom poisoning or Organophosphate poisoning with cholinergic symptoms. Atropine is the DOC in organophosphate poisoning.

Antidotes:

  • Atropine – OP poisoning
  • N acetylcysteine – Paracetamol overdose
  • Naloxone – Opiod poisoning
  • Physostigmine - Atropine
  • Organophosphate poisoning permanently block the AchE and thus increase Ach which leads to various muscarinic effects
  • M1: Increases gastric HCl
  • M2 : CVS effects🡪decreases HR and BP
  • M3 : Pinpoint pupils, Increased secretions (Severe diarrhea), Urinary incontinence, Broncho-constriction .
